degrees from true north
Set your location to get the bearing.
A phone compass is a magnetometer: metal, speakers, cases and cars pull it off. Turn the phone in a slow figure of eight to settle it, and check it against the sun before you rely on it. The bearing itself is exact — only the compass needle is a guess.

Baik Premium

Every dua stays free. Always.

Premium supports the app and unlocks the tools around the duas: recitation audio, unlimited saves and notes, guided journeys, deeper study and offline packs. It never puts a dua behind a price.

Or simply give

If you do not need the extra tools but want this to keep going, you can contribute instead. Every ringgit given goes back into the app: scholar review of the duas, recitation recordings, artwork and translation. Nothing is unlocked by giving, and nothing is asked of you.

Prices in ringgit. Monthly renews on card; annual and lifetime are paid once.
